515:t_009:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't lose! I'll be damned if I lose!!」

515:t_010:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop, $$リディ$$! Using that power like that will only destroy you!」

515:t_011:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「His anger is so naked...! This is dangerous!」

515:t_011:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Now we're on equal footing!」

515:t_011:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'll defeat you with this thing's power!!」

515:t_012:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Here I come, $c! I'll show you its... No, my power!」

515:t_013:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「So some $$ザフト$$ forces were still here!」

515:t_014:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Have they come to protect the $$コーディネイター$$s?」

515:t_015:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「They're targeting $$アプリリウス$$, too!?」

515:t_015:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「I can understand attacking Ensign $$リディ$$, a Conservative, but why attack $$プラント$$...!?」

515:t_015:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They must be acting on the same crazy logic as their captain!」

515:t_015:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「And it seems they've made us a higher priority than Ensign $$リディ$$.」

515:t_015:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, intercept Ensign $$リディ$$ while protecting $$プラント$$ from the Reformists!」

515:t_015:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's easy to say, but we're in a pretty tight spot!」

515:t_015:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We don't have enough forces to handle this...!」

515:t_016:3.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「$$シン$$... With those injuries, you can't fight...」

515:t_016:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll take the lead. $$シン$$, cover me.」

515:t_016:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let me help you for a change. I'm your friend, too.」

515:t_016:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$キラ$$ and $$シン$$, defend $$アプリリウス$$! All other units, focus your attacks on Ensign $$リディ$$!」

515:t_016:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「With this power, even I can do it!」

515:t_016:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The $$バンシィ$$... You've finally unleashed its power.」

515:t_016:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I have to do this...! If Ensign $$リディ$$ keeps fighting, something irreversible will happen!」

515:t_017:1.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「You're pushing yourself too hard, $$シン$$!」

515:t_017:2.en:
$$シン$$
「No, $$ルナ$$! I'm a member of $$ザフト$$, too!」

515:t_017:4.en:
$$シン$$
「The war is what made $$レイ#pt136$$ try to carry on the Chairman's plan and made me lose the ability to think for myself...!」

515:t_017:5.en:
$$シン$$
「If $$プラント$$ burns here and now, it'll create more children like me and $$レイ#pt136$$!」

515:t_018:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's been a while, $n, $$セツコ$$, and everyone in $c, too.」

515:t_018:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Why are you attacking $$プラント$$!?」

515:t_018:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「Aren't $$コーディネイター$$s something you Reformists created!?」

515:t_018:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「For descendants of the Reformists to cozy up to $$サイデリアル$$ is utterly unacceptable.」

515:t_018:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now that they've lost their ideals, they're no longer our comrades. Therefore, purging them is also my duty.」

515:t_018:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll start with you, bearers of the factors.」

515:t_019:0.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「It's a shame. Now that they've lost their ideals, $$コーディネイター$$s are nothing but meaningless beings.」

515:t_019:1.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「You're an empty species created solely for your abilities. In other words, you're monsters of space.」

515:t_019:3.en:
$$シン$$
「$$コーディネイター$$s... We are...!」

515:t_020:0.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$キラ$$ and $$シン$$ aren't monsters.」

515:t_020:4.en:
$$アーサー$$
「I'm sorry, $$シン$$. My mistake allowed the Chairman of the National Defense Committee to escape.」

515:t_020:5.en:
$$シン$$
「I understand! Thank you, XO $$アーサー$$!」

515:t_021:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's do this with your power and mine, $$アスラン$$!」

515:t_022:0.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That's amazing! You haven't done this in ages, but you're perfectly in sync!」

515:t_022:1.en:
$$シン$$
「We can't let them outdo us, $$レイ#pt136$$!」

515:t_023:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's go, $$レイ#pt136$$! We'll bring your feelings and mine together!」

515:t_024:0.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It's been a while since we were in sync like this...」

515:t_024:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Of course it does! We've brought all our strength together!」

515:t_024:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's do this, $$レイ#pt136$$. We're going to protect $$プラント$$.」
